mappings.title: Conversion mappings
mappings.intro: How Port blueprints correspond to Backstage kinds. A mapping is data — administrators edit it as JSON; the export to Backstage and the Backstage import both read it.
mappings.loadFailed: Could not load the conversion mappings
mappings.notFound: This conversion mapping no longer exists

field.name: Name
field.nameHint: A single-line display name, unique among the mappings (up to 100 characters)
field.documentHint: schemaVersion 1: pairs of a blueprint and a Backstage kind, each with its rules. Validated against the current blueprints and registries on save.

validation.documentSyntax: The document is not valid JSON ({{message}})
validation.documentObject: The document must be a JSON object

findings.rejectedTitle: The mapping was not saved — it has blocking findings
findings.storedTitle: Blocking findings — this mapping went stale and cannot be saved until they are fixed
findings.driftTitle: Drift — the mapping no longer matches a registry it mirrors (does not block saving)
findings.clean: No findings and no drift against the current blueprints and registries.

mappings.saveForbidden: Only administrators can edit conversion mappings
mappings.saveConflict: A conversion mapping with this name already exists
mappings.saveInvalid: The mapping was refused — the registry may be full (20 mappings) or the document larger than 256 KiB
mappings.saveGone: This conversion mapping no longer exists — reload the page
mappings.deleteBody: The mapping "{{name}}" will be removed. Converting between Backstage and Port with it will no longer be possible.
mappings.deleteFailed: Could not delete the conversion mapping

rows.summary: {{total}} rows — {{converted}} converted, {{withFindings}} with findings, {{skipped}} skipped, {{invalid}} invalid
rows.truncated: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}} rows — the counts above cover all of them.

error.mappingGone: This conversion mapping no longer exists — reload the page.
error.mappingStale: This mapping has blocking findings and cannot convert until they are fixed.
error.busy: The server is busy reading the workspace — try again in a moment.
error.failedNetwork: The conversion failed. Check your connection and try again.
error.refusedExport: The request was refused — the entity query is invalid (see its diagnostics) or the selection is too large to convert in one go.
error.refusedImport: The documents were refused — a request takes at most 200 of them, and a malformed one is rejected.

export.title: Export to Backstage
export.intro: Convert stored Port entities into Backstage catalog files through a conversion mapping. Converting stores nothing — files are only created or updated when you confirm.
export.noMappings: There are no conversion mappings yet.
export.mappingStaleAlert: The mapping went stale after a blueprint or registry edit — fix its blocking findings first.
export.mergeHint: On: only the fields the mapping owns are replaced in a stored file of the same identity; everything else in it survives. Off: the bare converted document.
export.noBlueprints: Every blueprint is hidden — nothing is selected.
export.queryHint: Convert uses the APPLIED entity query (the one you last ran — it is shared with the Entity graph and hierarchy), the filters and the visible blueprints.
export.yamlEmpty: No catalog files to show — nothing converted.

createModal.title: Create / update catalog files
createModal.previewBody: This is what the import would do, computed from a fresh conversion. Files with an existing identity are replaced in place (soft findings are waived, as in every import). Nothing is stored until you confirm, and Confirm converts once more right before storing.
createModal.doneTitle: Done — these are the stored results.
createModal.checkSummary: {{stored}} of {{total}} would be stored — {{created}} created, {{updated}} updated, {{unchanged}} unchanged
createModal.storedBeforeFailure: These files were stored before the failure:
createModal.stoppedAfter: Stopped after {{sent}} of {{total}} files — the files above were stored, the rest were not sent.
createModal.truncated: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}} rows, the ones that need attention first — the counts above cover all of them.

export.chunkNote: More than {{size}} files are written in chunks of {{size}}; a reference between files in different chunks surfaces as a finding on the later file.

import.intro: Paste, pick or fetch a Backstage catalog-info.yaml and convert it into Port entities through a conversion mapping. Importing replaces existing entities of the same blueprint and identifier.
import.mergeHint: On: only the fields the mapping owns are replaced in a stored entity; Port-only data survives. Off: the bare converted document overwrites the entity.
import.replaceNote: Import replaces existing entities of the same blueprint and identifier. Check and Import convert the YAML again right before they run, so a Port edit made since your last preview is not overwritten by a stale merge.
import.chunkNote: More than {{size}} documents are converted in chunks; a reference between files in different chunks is only resolved against what is already stored.

confirm.title: Import into Port
confirm.mergeOff: Merge is off: each converted document replaces its Port entity wholesale — properties, relations and ownership that exist only in Port are lost.
confirm.preview: A fresh conversion and the dry run it leads to. Nothing is stored until you confirm; Confirm converts once more right before importing.
confirm.done: Imported — the conversion that was written, and the stored rows.
confirm.storedBeforeFailure: These entities were stored before the failure:
confirm.stoppedAfter: Stopped after {{sent}} of {{total}} chunks — the chunks that completed were stored, the rest were not sent.
